component.name: HomeScene

Label.text: Live TV Network - pick a channel to tune in

component.script:
sub init() m.grid = m.top.findNode("grid") m.status = m.top.findNode("status")
m.grid.observeField("itemSelected", "onChannelSelected") m.grid.observeField("itemFocused", "onChannelFocused")
m.grid.setFocus(true)
fetchChannels() end sub
sub fetchChannels() m.status.text = "Loading channels..." m.fetcher = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ChannelsFetcher") m.fetcher.apiBase = m.top.apiBase m.fetcher.observeField("channels", "onChannelsLoaded") m.fetcher.observeField("error", "onChannelsError") m.fetcher.control = "RUN" end sub
sub onChannelsLoaded() payload = m.fetcher.channels if payload = invalid or payload.list = invalid m.status.text = "No channels returned" return end if m.channels = payload.list content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each ch in m.channels it = content.createChild("ContentNode") it.title = ch.name it.HDGRIDPOSTERURL = firstNonEmpty(ch.thumbnail, "pkg:/images/icon_side_hd.png") it.id = ch.id end for m.grid.content = content m.status.text = "Ready - " + m.channels.Count().ToStr() + " channels. Press OK to tune in." end sub
sub onChannelsError() m.status.text = "Network error: " + m.fetcher.error end sub
function firstNonEmpty(a as dynamic, b as string) as string if a <> invalid and type(a) = "String" and a <> "" then return a return b end function
sub onChannelFocused() idx = m.grid.itemFocused if idx < 0 or idx >= m.channels.Count() then return m.status.text = "Focused: " + m.channels[idx].name + " - press OK to tune in" end sub
sub onChannelSelected() idx = m.grid.itemSelected if idx < 0 or idx >= m.channels.Count() then return ch = m.channels[idx] m.status.text = "Tuning in to " + ch.name + "..."
player = m.top.findNode("player") if player = invalid player = m.top.createChild("LivePlayer") player.id = "player" player.apiBase = m.top.apiBase player.observeField("closed", "onPlayerClosed") end if player.channel = { id: ch.id, name: ch.name } player.visible = true player.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onPlayerClosed() player = m.top.findNode("player") if player <> invalid then player.visible = false m.grid.setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" player = m.top.findNode("player") if player <> invalid and player.visible player.visible = false m.grid.setFocus(true) return true end if end if return false end function
